title: advisory-priors v1
description: Advisory input file for the Meshloop kernel (ADR 0038, amendment 2026-11-10 for #139). The nodecode-meshloop cell writes it as a proposal; it has effect only after `meshloop priors accept --file F --as <identity>` and only while the latest promotion record's SHA-256 equals the accepted copy. The kernel loader, not this schema, is the authority: it also checks the evidence floor, provenance length == attempts, successes <= attempts, the configured candidate set and the `{model_ref}` template. A file-level failure (not JSON, wrong schema or version, over 1 MiB) means no priors; an entry-level failure ignores that entry only; unknown fields are ignored. Every case yields a diagnostic, never a failed command. No field carries worker output.

source.description: Optional pointers to what was folded. Display only.

priors.description: Routing priors. The kernel derives pi = (successes + 1) / (attempts + 2) and passes it through the PredictiveSuccessOracle port into fused_historical_mean; the file never states pi.

tier_hints.description: Raise-only suggestions shown at plan review. Never read at routing time.

notes.description: Planning lessons and repair constraints. Advisory text shown at plan review only; never parsed into policy, prompts, paths or checks.

attempt_ref.description: An attempt Meshloop dispatched as subprocess and verified itself.

decision_ref.description: A plan decision Meshloop recorded, identified by graph and plan digest.

model_ref.description: The model recorded on the attempt rows (#134). Empty, whitespace-bearing, '-'-prefixed, over 256 bytes and `unverified` (ADR 0039) are refused.

dispatch_mode.description: Positive marker. Only subprocess attempts are evidence for #139.

provenance.description: One reference per counted attempt; the loader requires length == attempts.

path_prefix.description: Repository-relative prefix matched against a node's allowed_paths.

to_tier.description: Must be higher than from_tier; the loader ignores any other entry.

text.description: One line from a deterministic cell template over counts and ids. Never quotes worker output, evidence summaries or node descriptions.
